highlights.title: Gemini sign-in asks about your data
highlights.line: Signing Gemini in with a Google subscription shows Antigravity's terms in Kosmos and asks before Google may collect your data.

highlights.title: Settings stays clickable
highlights.line: On a long Settings section, the section buttons stay below the top bar instead of sliding under it.

highlights.title: Leftovers never touch a running agent
highlights.line: Deleting a leftover agent by name, in any capitals, no longer touches an agent of that name that is running.
